hypothesis: Blind geothermal conduits and their bounding structures reactivate as short, linear, vent-proximal scarps that the scarp-dependent USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue never traced; they are recoverable from LiDAR scarp linearity, not from catalogue proximity.
mechanism: fold-aware logistic propensity (out-of-fold, visible catalogue only) + 21 documented vents/wells proximity prior (1.5 km decay) + scarp ridge-continuity term; cell-of-max thinning at 2.8 px, B=2.0 px catalogue collar, LiDAR-valid pixels only, budget 44090 dots.
named_non_fault_process: alluvial-fan toes, paleo-shoreline benches, terrace risers, lava-flow margins and road cuts all produce linear scarp-like steps; mitigated by requiring ridge continuity AND a vent-proximity term AND catalogue detachment, but not eliminated.
